\chapter{Boolean Analysis — Rounding}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Applications.KKL.Rounding
\section{Overview}
Averaging outside a coordinate set is the corresponding Fourier projection. Random restrictions yield Boolean juntas whose disagreement is at most half the omitted Fourier weight.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[Character under coordinate averaging]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.expect_chiS_coordinateRestriction}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_const, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_neg, BooleanAnalysis.chiS, BooleanAnalysis.chiS_flipBit_eq, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.expect_eq_fintypeExpect, BooleanAnalysis.flipBit, BooleanAnalysis.flipBit_flipBit}
\difficulty{5}
Let $S,J\subseteq[n]$ and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, and let $x\star_J y$ equal $x$ on $J$ and $y$ elsewhere. Then for uniform $y$, $\mathbb E_y\chi_S(x\star_J y)=\chi_S(x)$ if $S\subseteq J$, and zero otherwise.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Fourier formula for coordinate averaging]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.expect_coordinateRestriction_eq_sum_fourier}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.expect_chiS_coordinateRestriction, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_const_mul, BooleanAnalysis.chiS, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.expect_eq_fintypeExpect, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.walsh_expansion}
\difficulty{4}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $J\subseteq[n]$, and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. If $x\star_Jy$ keeps $x$ on $J$ and $y$ elsewhere, then $\mathbb E_y f(x\star_Jy)=\sum_{S\subseteq J}\widehat f(S)\chi_S(x)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Mean disagreement with random restrictions]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.expect_disagreement_coordinateRestriction}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.expect_coordinateRestriction_eq_sum_fourier, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.disagreementProbability, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_const, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_const_mul, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_sub, BooleanAnalysis.chiS, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.expect_eq_fintypeExpect, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, BooleanAnalysis.parseval_pm_one}
\difficulty{5}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $J\subseteq[n]$. For uniform independent $z$ and $x$, and $x\star_Jz$ keeping $x$ on $J$ and $z$ elsewhere, $\mathbb E_z\Pr_x(f(x)\ne f(x\star_Jz))=\tfrac12\sum_{S\nsubseteq J}\widehat f(S)^2$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Boolean junta from omitted Fourier weight]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.exists_boolean_junta_of_fourier_omission}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.expect_disagreement_coordinateRestriction, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.disagreementProbability, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_const, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.expect_mono, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.fourierCoeff, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, KKL.IsJunta}
\difficulty{5}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube and $J\subseteq[n]$. There exists $h:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ depending only on $J$ such that $\Pr(f\ne h)\le\tfrac12\sum_{S\nsubseteq J}\widehat f(S)^2$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Boolean constant approximation]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.exists_boolean_constant_approximation}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance_eq_sum_nonempty_fourier, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.exists_boolean_junta_of_fourier_omission, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.disagreementProbability, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, KKL.IsJunta}
\difficulty{1}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube. There exists a constant $h:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ such that $\Pr(f\ne h)\le\operatorname{Var}(f)/2$.
\end{lemma}
